Package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities

Class Goose

java.lang.Object
io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities.Entity
io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities.Goose
public class Goose extends Entity
Goose class. Stores one instance of a goose, the main "enemy" of the game. They can be fed or scared away. GooseManager manages an Array of geese.
